title: Built-In Transportation Expense under Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage
content:
**Benefit.** When the vehicle has a covered loss and carries no Cardinal Rental Reimbursement option, the built-in transportation expense of Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage pays the customer's documented rental or transportation costs at the option's daily figure (20.00 USD) up to the option's per-loss maximum (600.00 USD). It starts 48 hours after a total theft is reported, or 24 hours after any other covered loss, and ends when the vehicle is repaired, or when the total-loss settlement is offered. When the vehicle carries a rental reimbursement option, the built-in benefit does not apply, and the two are never added together. It is paid without a deductible, as the transportation expense component of the claim.

**Amount.** The payment is the lower of the daily figure multiplied by the benefit days and the per-loss maximum. The benefit days are the whole calendar days, from the end of the waiting period after the loss report to the day the repair is completed or the total-loss settlement is offered, for which the customer documents a rental or transportation cost.

## Condition and result

| Cardinal Rental Reimbursement option on the vehicle | Covered loss | Built-in transportation expense |
|---|---|---|
| No | Yes | Applies |
| Yes | Yes | Does not apply |

## Worked examples (hypothetical figures)

- A hail loss; after the 24-hour wait the customer documents 12 days of rental until the repair is completed: 20.00 multiplied by 12 gives 240.00, below the 600.00 maximum, so 240.00 is paid with no deductible.
- A total theft; after the 48-hour wait the customer documents 35 days of transportation cost until the settlement is offered: 20.00 multiplied by 35 gives 700.00, so the 600.00 maximum is paid.
